summary.text: Troy Waymaster is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 109 since January 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Waymaster took office representing Kansas House District 109 on January 14, 2013.

In the 2025–2026 session he chaired the Appropriations Committee and the House Legislative Budget Committee, and he had chaired the Appropriations Committee in the 2021–2022 and 2023–2024 sessions as well.
